qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global leader in in-vitro diagnostics and proprietary oncology/neurology biologics. Installed instrument base creates high switching costs and recurring reagent toll booths, while proprietary Genentech antibody platform delivers continuous replacement blockbusters (Vabysmo, Ocrevus, Hemlibra) with resilient global pricing power.

Balance sheet fortress with 13.6x interest coverage.
